item.title: Pokemon GO Reveals September Community Day Classic Pokemon
item.description:
Pokemon GO has confirmed that Gible will be the focus of its next Community Day Classic on September 12, 2026. The event is the first of its kind in Pokemon GO 's upcoming Halloween-themed season, and will feature some juicy rewards such as Mega Energy.

Although the game is still wrapping up its Forever Forward season, developer Scopely has already revealed the dates for Pokemon GO 's next three Community Day events. Among them is a Community Day Classic event, which is when Pokemon GO brings back either a powerful Pokemon or a fan-favorite one from the game's early days. These events are also a great opportunity for fans to hunt for 100% Pokemon or shiny copies. Ahead of its September 2026 edition, the developers have unveiled which critter will be its star.

Pokemon GO Players Can Get Special Pokemon For Free, But There's a Catch

Pokemon GO gives away free rewards from rare Pokemon to in-game cosmetics, but claiming them won't be as straightforward as some might like.

By Diana Velásquez Vargas

Pokemon GO Reveals Gible for September 2026 Community Day Classic

  • Saturday, September 12 from 2:00 PM to 5:00 PM local time

Gible will star in Pokemon GO 's next Community Day Classic on September 12, from 2:00 PM to 5:00 PM. During this time, the Dragon and Ground dual-type will spawn more frequently in the wild. Fans will have the chance to encounter a shiny Gible or one with a limited background. Fans can also unlock the Ground-type Charged Attack Earth Power by evolving Gible into Garchomp until 9:00 PM. On the other hand, what sets Gible's Community Day Classic apart is a new Collection Challenge that rewards Garchomp Mega Energy and other leveling materials. Players only need to complete Gible's evolution line during the event to receive the perks. This challenge may come in handy for fans considering that Mega Garchomp is a solid unit against Electric-types like Mega Raichu in Pokemon GO .

Additionally, fans will earn three times the XP from catching Pokemon, and regular Incense will last for three hours. Lure Modules will also last for one hour until 9:00 PM, and Shiny Gible will have an even higher spawn probability around them. Finally, event-themed Field Research challenges will be available, and completing them will grant players extra encounters with Gible, Great Balls, Stardust, and more. Players can also purchase a $2 Community Day Special Research for three guaranteed Gible with a special background, a Premium Battle Pass, and more items. Gible's Day is the first major event launching during Pokemon GO 's upcoming Twilight Trails season, which kicks off on September 8.

Gible's first Community Day was in 2021, so giving it its own Classic edition had been a long time coming. However, many players were also disappointed that September will not have a standard Community Day featuring a more recent Pokemon. Instead, the next edition will be on October 10, and earlier leaks suggested that it coincides with Zorua's first Community Day in Pokemon GO . Of course, leaks should be taken with a grain of salt, but since the fox-like monster was a main focus in the Twilight Trails trailer, Zorua will likely star in some form of limited event in the coming months.

item.title: How to Save the Missing Group in Stalker 2: Cost of Hope (Dangerous Way Quest)
item.description:
Dangerous Way is one of Freedom's main missions in Stalker 2: Cost of Hope DLC that will require Skif to save the missing group by finding the Water Drop artifact. Getting the artifact is important, as you won't be able to pass through the silver mercury anomaly without it. The Mercury anomaly is particularly problematic as it'll damage Skif by latching onto him with tendrils. Here's a complete Dangerous Way quest guide to help you find the Water Drop artifact to save the missing group in Stalker 2: Cost of Hope .

The Dangerous Way quest is only available to players who sided with Mavka during "The Destructive Power of the Mind" main mission in Stalker 2: Cost of Hope .

How to Get the Artifact from Iron Forest Flare Fragment in Stalker 2: Cost of Hope

There's an artifact inside the Flare Fragment POI in the Iron Forest that players can retrieve by following this method in Stalker 2: Cost of Hope.

By Ayyoun Ali

Where to Find Barque's Missing Group

Once you've finished the conversation with Barque during the Dangerous Way quest in Stalker 2: Cost of Hope , head to the objective marker, and you'll arrive in a room filled with Mercury anomalies. While avoiding getting hit by one of its tendrils, make sure to avoid stepping into puddles of Mercury on the ground .

If you're caught by Mercury's tendrils, simply shoot the base of each tendril locked onto you to escape it.

You'll need to head to the location marked on the map above. Simply head to the section marked above and examine the broken wall to meet Keel and Vanko, who are Barque's missing men. They'll mention how Skif needs to get through the Mercury using a special artifact to reach the explosives, and also hand him the Storage Key.

How to Get the Artifact in the Dangerous Way Mission in Stalker 2: Cost of Hope

After talking to Keel and Vanko, players will need to head downstairs and take out all the enemies there . Once all the enemies are taken care of, head inside the shooting range area and open up the iron gate using the Storage Key.

After getting into the storage room, you'll need to climb the ladder to get to the upper floor. At the end of the corridor here, climb up the boxes and get on top of the pipes that run along the room. After walking across the pipes, jump across the gap and enter the open door to the left.

Inside the room, you'll spot the artifact hovering in the air next to the wall. You won't be able to reach the artifact by jumping, and instead will need to shoot it and move it to a better location . It's basically like playing pinball with the artifact.

There are stacks of boxes in the corner of the area to the right that you can get on top of to grab the hovering artifact. Of course, you'll need to shoot the artifact to get it there first. Once you've grabbed it, equip the Water Drop artifact in Stalker 2: Cost of Hope by going into your backpack (inventory) menu.

The Water Drop artifact will allow you to pass through the walls of Mercury, essentially opening up new areas to explore.

How to Get Explosives From the Warehouse

Once you've equipped the Water Drop artifact during the Dangerous Way quest, head through the wall of Mercury to the left side of the room to enter an office in the back. Here, climb up the boxes next to the wall to reach the open ventilation duct above.

After following the vent, you'll drop into a room full of Mercury anomaly. Keep going through the walls of Mercury till you eventually come across the C4-Charge . Grab the charge, hop over the boxes, and turn left to exit the room and return to the broken wall. Plant the Detonator on the wall to destroy it and save Barque's missing group of soldiers.

Now, you can talk to Keel and take the Monorail activation key by either talking to him or simply defeating him. Either way, you'll progress to the final stages of the Dangerous Way quest in Stalker 2: Cost of Hope .

item.title: How to Flashy Pass in NBA 2K27
item.description:
Passing is a core part of basketball and NBA 2K27 , no matter a player's position. However, for floor general Point Guards and playmaking Centers, there's more than just a simple pass with [A]. Despite their name, flashy passes are more than just a chance to showboat, as they can be used to fool opponents and find teammates from unexpected angles. It also helps if the player has high ball control and passing stats, ideally high enough to meet the requirements of passing Badges in NBA 2K27 ​​.

How to Alley Oop in NBA 2K27

Learn how to perform alley-oops in NBA 2K27 as both the passer and receiver.

By Joe Grantham

How To Flashy Pass In NBA 2K27

Flashy passes can include no looks, behind the backs, and over the shoulders, depending on the scenario and the player making the pass. The controls for flashy passing have changed since the last edition of NBA 2K , so make sure you learn the new way.

To perform a flashy pass in NBA 2K27 , use the following controls.

  • Press [RB] and aim with [RS]

Using [RS] to aim is different from all other passes, where [LS] is used.

Having higher tiers of the V ersatile Visionary , Dimer , and Bail Out Badges will help with flashy passing and other aspects of your passing game, leading to more assists.

Best Teams for Small Forwards in MyCareer in NBA 2K27

The following modern and historic teams lack star forwards, making them ideal for rising Small Forwards in NBA 2K27's MyCareer.

By Joe Grantham

How To Wrap Pass In NBA 2K27

Wraparound passes or wrap passes in basketball are essentially where the passer puts extra effort into passing around a defender , often using their own body to protect the ball . At the cost of a little speed, the pass is less likely to be intercepted. When being pressed or double-teamed , a wrap pass may be necessary .

  • Double tap [B]

To perform a wrap pass in NBA 2K27 ​, the passer must be guarded or under some form of pressure.

How To Bounce Pass In NBA 2K27

Another option for passing is the bounce pass , which can avoid a defender's outstretched arm by going under. Bounce passes can also be more precise in certain circumstances.

To perform a bounce pass in NBA 2K27 ​​​​​, there needs to be a reasonable gap between the passer and intended receiver; otherwise, they will just hand it over.

  • Press [B]

When players have mastered passing, they will want to find the best teams for Point Guards in NBA 2K27's MyCareer, which now includes options from historical eras.

item.title: Sly Cooper Making a Comeback
item.description:
A group of passionate Sly Cooper fans are bringing the franchise to the PC for the first time, working on getting Sly Cooper and the Thievius Raccoonus running on PC. The Sly Cooper port would be the first time the franchise has had a native playable version on PC.

The stealth games centered around the titular raccoon protagonist quickly became one of Sony's most popular franchises of the early 2000s. The Sly Cooper series had its heyday on the PlayStation 2, releasing a trilogy of games that received universal praise from fans and critics alike. Though Sucker Punch has referenced Sly Cooper in games like Ghost of Yotei , the franchise has not received a fully new game in over a decade since the release of Sly Cooper: Thieves in Time in 2012. Now, a group of Sly Cooper fans are attempting to develop a native port of the original game on PC.

PlayStation Confirms New State of Play for This Week

Sony confirms a dual State of Play event for its PlayStation brand and fans don't have to wait long to see what the company has planned.

1
By Derek Nichols

Sly Cooper Fans Are Attempting to Create a Native PC Port

Project Cane is a bold new fan project aiming to get Sly Cooper and the Thievius Racconus to run natively on PC. The project intends to fully rebuild the code of the original Sly Cooper game to run without the use of an emulator, using the original data from the game to recreate it on PC. Project Cane has released a PC demonstration of the game, showing off the "A Stealthy Approach" mission, complete with cutscenes and gameplay. Project Cane confirmed that the native PC port of Sly Cooper is still in early development, with no confirmed release date.

Project Cane's port of Sly Cooper will give fans a brand-new way to experience the beloved mascot platformer. The original Sly Cooper games were exclusive to the PS2, only receiving ports to newer Sony consoles. The Sly Collection , released in 2010 as a compilation of the first three games, launched as a PS3 exclusive and later received a port to PlayStation Vita. Even Sly Cooper: Thieves in Time never saw an official launch outside a Sony console, with the game launching simultaneously on the PS3 and Vita. Developer Sucker Punch has also confirmed that the studio is likely done with the Sly Cooper franchise.

Sly Cooper was one of a multitude of mascot franchises from different developers published by Sony throughout the PS2 era. The Jak and Daxter franchise was a fan-favorite following the original release of Jak and Daxter: The Precursor Legacy , also launching a trilogy of games on the console, with fans now clamoring for a Jak and Daxter remake. Ratchet and Clank was also a mainstay throughout the PS2 and PS3 era, with four games released on the PS2 and occasionally reappearing in the years since, including 2021's Ratchet and Clank: Rifts Apart reviving the series after eight years of dormancy.

While mascot platformers are not as ubiquitous as their prime in the late 1990s and early 2000s, Sony has plenty of modern examples of successful series. LittleBigPlanet was a smash hit for Sony in the PS3 era, with the customizable platformer series winning multiple awards and turning Sackboy into a major mascot for PlayStation. The popular Astro Bot series has been a particularly recent example of Sony striking gold with its mascot platformers, with Astro Bot winning Game of the Year at the 2024 Game Awards. The Sly Cooper port brings back a classic adventure from one of Sony's most beloved mascots.

Project Cane is a bold new fan project aiming to get Sly Cooper and the Thievius Racconus to run natively on PC. The project intends to fully rebuild the code of the original Sly Cooper game to run without the use of an emulator, using the original data from the game to recreate it on PC. Project Cane has released a PC demonstration of the game, showing off the "A Stealthy Approach" mission, complete with cutscenes and gameplay. Project Cane confirmed that the native PC port of Sly Cooper is still in early development, with no confirmed release date.

Project Cane's port of Sly Cooper will give fans a brand-new way to experience the beloved mascot platformer. The original Sly Cooper games were exclusive to the PS2, only receiving ports to newer Sony consoles. The Sly Collection , released in 2010 as a compilation of the first three games, launched as a PS3 exclusive and later received a port to PlayStation Vita. Even Sly Cooper: Thieves in Time never saw an official launch outside a Sony console, with the game launching simultaneously on the PS3 and Vita. Developer Sucker Punch has also confirmed that the studio is likely done with the Sly Cooper franchise.

The Jak and Daxter franchise was a fan-favorite following the original release of Jak and Daxter: The Precursor Legacy , also launching a trilogy of games on the console, with fans now clamoring for a Jak and Daxter remake. Ratchet and Clank was also a mainstay throughout the PS2 and PS3 era, with four games released on the PS2 and occasionally reappearing in the years since, including 2021's Ratchet and Clank: Rifts Apart reviving the series after eight years of dormancy.

LittleBigPlanet was a smash hit for Sony in the PS3 era, with the customizable platformer series winning multiple awards and turning Sackboy into a major mascot for PlayStation. The popular Astro Bot series has been a particularly recent example of Sony striking gold with its mascot platformers, with Astro Bot winning Game of the Year at the 2024 Game Awards. item.title: How to Get the Artifact from Iron Forest Flare Fragment in Stalker 2: Cost of Hope
item.description:
The Flare Fragment POI is an anomalous area within the Iron Forest that also holds an artifact introduced in Stalker 2: Cost of Hope . Like all other anomalies, getting the artifact from this area won't be easy, as it induces nightmarish flashes in players due to high PSI radiation. Here's a quick guide to help players get the artifact in the Flare Fragment POI in the Iron Forest without suffering from PSI-radiation flashes.

If you haven't begun the expansion yet, check out my guide on how to start the Stalker 2: Cost of Hope DLC.

How to Find 'Apartment Code' in Stalker 2: Cost of Hope (Shadows of the Past)

Here's how players can find the apartment code while exploring Lymansk in the Shadows of the Past quest in Stalker 2: Cost of Hope DLC.

By Ayyoun Ali

How to Get the Artifact from Iron Forest Flare Fragment POI in Stalker 2: Cost of Hope

For players who haven't visited the anomalous area yet, the Flare Fragment POI is located within the Iron Forest, one of the new regions added in Stalker 2: Cost of Hope DLC . It's located in the western portion of the area, near the Chief's Bunker .

The trick to avoiding getting nightmare flashed by the Flare Fragment is to quickly finding a cover to broke your line of sight with it. You'll need to slowly make your way to the area in the image above by moving from cover to cover.

Once you're near these metal beams, make sure to first clear the area by shooting the boxes and the electro-orb anomaly . Once the area is clear, carefully make your way up the metal structure and quickly hide and break your line of sight with the anomaly by getting behind one of the metal beams.

Make sure to equip bolts, as you'll need to get rid of Springboard and Vortex anomalies . Once the path is clear, quickly move forward on the metal structure and get to the next cover.

To clear the path ahead, all you need to do is shoot the electro-orb anomaly on the tower above and disable the Vortex anomaly in front of you by throwing a bolt. After that, jump down to the lower structure and get behind cover.

Here, you'll find a bag filled with some vital resources, and finally get the Flickering Flare artifact from the Flare Fragment POI in Stalker 2: Cost of Hope DLC . Equipping this artifact will increase flat 2 stat points of PSI protection.

To safely get down without taking fall damage, jump on top of the gravitation anomaly on the ground . This will break your fall and allow you to continue moving away from the Flare Fragment anomaly.
